input.brief: Bastion autonomous blue-team security console: live request-lifecycle graph, incidents log, blue investigator agent reasoning, red attacker agent campaigns

style.name: Data terminal
style.basis: 1 screen: a stock research view. Keep it narrow.
style.idea: A research or monitoring screen read in long sessions: cards darker than the ground, tabular digits that stack, signs instead of colour, and every selection marked by the same 1px accent line.
style.colourBudget: under 3%; the accent is never more than a 1px line

font.note: Section titles 20/400 in the muted grey; card titles 16/600; tabular figures everywhere.

style.signature: Every selection (tab, toggle, range, nav item) is a 1px accent line exactly as wide as its label, placed on the nearest existing edge; numbers stay white or grey and carry their sign in the text ('+$24,000,000').
identity: Every figure in a monospace as the style's decision (IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono for each price, count and time, digits that stack), with the text in Public Sans. Lint and the inspector flag mono; give the reason in the report.
The one accent line from the product's world in place of the dealt blue (the exchange's or the team's hue): still the only selection mark, never violet or indigo.
A signature of the market or the system as the lead: an order book's depth as two mirrored bar lists, an incident as a minute-by-minute strip, a region map with the list beside it.
avoid: filled pill tabs or a coloured segmented control
a chart with no scale and no dates (the studied screen had none and was flagged)
tertiary text under 4.5:1 (#4c4c4f read at about 2:1 in the study)
lighter cards with borders and a glow
green and red on every number; the one column whose job is "what moved today" and a negative headline figure may carry the polarity colours
style.notes: The studied screen's muted grey #82848a and red #d4405d were lifted to #8a8c92 and #e5566f so text passes 4.5:1 on the card. Its card list rows sit on a 28px pitch and its table rows on 42px.

shell.name: Icon rail

numbers.active: icon colour alone, or a full-bleed 50px band at a 2% tint, or a 1px accent bar on the rail's border
numbers.utilities: pushed to the bottom after a gap of about 200px

shell.blueprint: An unlabelled rail of 50-60px carries the brand mark at the top and 15-18px outline icons on a 34-49px pitch; groups are split by 20px hairlines, utilities sit at the bottom. The rail sits on the page ground with a 1px edge, or is white with a faint 4px shadow on a grey ground. It saves about 180px of width against a labelled sidebar, so it suits products with few destinations and screens that need the width. Icons need tooltips and an accessible name.
shell.phone: The rail becomes a bottom bar with the same four or five icons, each with a short label under it.

pattern.name: Platform overview with a usage tray
pattern.blueprint: Sections stacked in one column about 48px apart, each with an 18/500 title on the left and a quiet action on the right ('View all', an outlined Refresh, a date-range button), and freshness in 14px grey after the title with a small status dot. First, a getting-started strip: one container split by 1px dividers into 4 equal cells (16/500 title, a 14px description, a grey arrow top right), shown until setup is done. Then the recent items table, capped at 4-5 rows on a 49px pitch: IDs in mono truncated to 8 characters plus an ellipsis with a copy icon, relative expiry in grey, rules that bleed 8px past the text column. Then usage: a #fafafa tray with 6px padding holding a KPI strip of 5 equal cells (a 14/500 label over a 24/400 value with a 14px unit suffix, '5 mins') and, 6px below, a chart card whose metric is chosen by the KPI cells themselves (the selected cell marked by a 2px rule or the active fill), never a second control repeating the KPI labels; the chart takes two-thirds of the width when its line is flat for most of the window, with the next answer beside it. Durations and timestamps in tabular figures. A missing value is a grey dash at label size, not '--' at value size.
pattern.phone: The getting-started strip becomes a 2 x 2 grid or a list; the table becomes two-line rows; the KPI strip a 2-column grid.

pattern.name: Table with tabs and a filter bar
pattern.basis: an events back office, a tracks studio, a sessions overview
pattern.blueprint: Title row: an 18-24px title on the left, at most an outlined secondary and the one primary (36px) on the right. Underline tabs for the list's states on a full-width 1px rule with a 2px indicator as wide as the label; 22-32px below, the toolbar: a search of about 252-316 x 32-36 on the left, the count ('7 events') and the sort on the right. The table sits on the panel or page ground with no card around it: a header of 12-13px grey sentence-case labels with no fill and no rule, rows on a 48-56px pitch for one line or 72-92px with a thumbnail (media height plus 24-32px), 1px rules 3-7% darker than the ground or no rules at all, the identity column given the most width, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures with the unit muted ('5 /10'), one status mark per row and one kebab at the far right. Drop a column that is empty in every row (a blank co-host column left a 300px dead band). On an overview, cap the rows and link to the full list; on the full list, state the total and load more at the end.
pattern.phone: Rows become two-line items: identity and the key number on line 1, the secondary fields in 13px grey on line 2, the kebab at the right. Tabs scroll in their own row; the search becomes a full-width field.

pattern.name: Research lists and a long table
pattern.blueprint: Header: a 26/700 title over a 20px grey date, quiet pill buttons on the right; a 1px rule about 44px below, with the tabs just under it and the active tab marked by a 1px accent line as wide as its label lying on that rule. 64px below, a 2-column row of cards at about 43/57 with a 24px gap: a ranked list on a 28px pitch (16px logo, bold ticker, grey name truncated, a right-aligned grey percentage and a white value, signs in the text) and a chart card with its legend in the header (5px dots, 13px grey labels), a text range selector under the baseline (1M 3M 6M YTD All, the active one marked by the same 1px accent segment) and 'Updated daily' in 11-12px grey. Then a 20/400 grey section title and a full-width table: a 38px header of 11-12px grey labels, 42px rows over 1px rules, ISO dates and every figure right-aligned in tabular numerals, white only for the identity and the total. Give the chart a y-scale and dates (the studied chart had neither and was flagged).
pattern.phone: Cards stack; the range selector stays as text under the chart; the table becomes two-line rows with the total on the right.
